hosted.update.title.note: Browser title and main heading of the hosted page where an applicant updates their application after the store asked for more information.

hosted.update.intro.note: Intro under the heading on the hosted update page. {store} is the store name.

hosted.update.messageLabel.note: Label above the store's own message to the applicant on the hosted update page.

hosted.update.submit.note: Submit button on the hosted update page.

hosted.update.doneHeading.note: Heading shown after the applicant sent their update.

hosted.update.doneBody.note: Text shown after the applicant sent their update. {store} is the store name.

hosted.link.invalidTitle.note: Heading when an update link is damaged or not for this store.

hosted.link.invalidBody.note: Explanation when an update link is damaged. {store} is the store name.

hosted.link.expiredTitle.note: Heading when an update link has expired.

hosted.link.expiredBody.note: Explanation when an update link has expired; tells the applicant to ask the store for a new one.

hosted.link.usedTitle.note: Heading when a single-use update link was already used.

hosted.link.usedBody.note: Explanation when a single-use update link was already used.

hosted.noscript.note: Shown on the hosted update page when the browser has JavaScript turned off.

hosted.error.generic.note: Shown on a hosted page when our server failed unexpectedly.
